Every site is back-in; posted driveway lengths run 22-74 ft, most 40 ft or more. Seven sites overlook Lake Superior.

values.note: 26 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 11 first-come (self-pay). The two-night minimum is a recreation.gov 'soft' rule and may be relaxed for a same-day booking; reservations close 4 days before arrival. Campers must occupy the site the first night. Operated by Camp Host, LLC under a Forest Service special use permit.

note: Ottawa NF campground beside the Black River Harbor Recreation Area at the river's mouth on Lake Superior, at the end of Black River Road (CR-513) about 15 miles north of Bessemer. Wooded, partly shaded sites bordered by vegetation. A footbridge crosses the river to the Lake Superior sand beaches; trails follow the river past a series of waterfalls (platforms and trails under major repair from May 2026, with temporary closures). CCC pavilion and harbor with charter fishing next door. --Claude
